task1.instruction: The bar chart shows the percentage of households with cars in a European country between 1971 and 2001. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.

task2.instruction: Films and computer games containing violence are very popular now. Some people think that they have a negative effect on our society and should be banned. Other people say they are harmless relaxation. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
